decision: Implement the four already specified preparation owner scopes under separate method/inventory/raw version with complete disposal and bounded controls/candidate only; keep all pilot flags false and select any later finite route separately.
limitations: Owned recorder/object/vector reclamation only; allocator retention and OS working set are not measured.
Allocation fault is an injected factory rejection, not an OS out-of-memory recovery proof.
No attribution/cost route ran; old trial disposal remains outside its original boundary and unavailable.
No sensitivity, shipping-cost, rendered target or M1 qualification.

editor.note: Capability/identity only. Wait need not have zero cycles. No sensitivity or cost pass.
